stories.title: More than 20 missing at Grand Canyon after flash flood
new_facts: New story: at least 15 hikers missing, dozens evacuated after Grand Canyon flash floods
Identifies specific flood site: creek leading to Colorado River in Grand Canyon
62 people evacuated Saturday; flooding destroyed nearly all footbridges across Bright Angel Creek
Updated count: at least 20 missing/unaccounted for; historic lodge near canyon bottom affected
Pins flood date to Aug. 29 and names Bright Angel Canyon/Phantom Ranch as flood zone
No injuries reported from the flash floods, per National Park Service
stories.line: Flash flooding at the Grand Canyon has left more than 20 people missing and forced dozens to evacuate; search operations are underway.

stories.title: Aon nears $17 billion acquisition of USI insurance broker
new_facts: Aon nears ~$17B deal to acquire insurance broker USI from KKR, including debt.
stories.line: Insurance broker Aon is acquiring competitor USI in a $17 billion deal, consolidating a sector where large firms dominate market share.

stories.title: NASA launches Roman Space Telescope after Trump's earlier effort to cancel it
new_facts: Trump personally called into NASA's press conference to congratulate the Roman team on launch success.
New on-record quote: 'We're just about to set foot off into the unknown.'
Telescope uses a donated Hubble-class mirror originally built for a spy satellite; images need half a million 4K TVs to display.
Roman will take a three-month journey to reach its orbit at the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point (L2).
Telescope will also observe black holes and exploding stars; Roman was NASA's first Chief of Astronomy.
stories.line: NASA launches the Roman Space Telescope, a $4.3 billion observatory designed to map distant galaxies and search for exoplanets.

stories.title: Anthropic refunds users after malware hijacks Claude accounts to rack up charges
new_facts: Anthropic signed out Claude users, removed saved payment methods, issued refunds after infostealer malware hijacked sessions to drain usage
stories.line: Anthropic locked out some Claude users and refunded charges after malware on their computers hijacked account sessions to run up API bills.
